definitions.gloss: thin; lightweight (of fabric, paper, or ware)
definitions.explanation: Made of thin material, used of clothing, cloth, paper, and pottery or glass.

examples.japanese: {薄手|うすで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薄手|うすで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ちょうどいい→ちょうどいい：21521_choudoii⟧。
examples.english: A light coat is just right for spring.

examples.japanese: {薄手|うすで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦グラス→グラス：00076_gurasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっそうおいしく⟦{感|かん}じられる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: Beer tastes even better from a thin glass.

notes:
Almost always used before a noun as {薄手|うすで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～. The opposite is ⟦{厚手|あつで}→厚手：28592_atsude⟧ (thick, heavy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄手|うすで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧: a light sweater
- {薄手|うすで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧: thin fabric
- {薄手|うすで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧: thin paper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: thin (the general adjective); {薄手|うすで} describes the material or make of an item, not a liquid or a color
